text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mukhisa Kituyi, member of parliament for Kimilili in Western province evades police after they threaten to arrest him over the death of student leader Solomon Muruli.
- Teachers' salaries for the month of February will be delayed due to technical problems.
- The Moi succession battle now pitches its tent in Ukambani as Nyiva Mwendwa and Kalonzo Musyoka go for each other's throat.
- Students interviewed this week dismiss the possibility that student leader Muruli committed suicide.
- The chief executive of Kenya Ports Authority Robert Brenneisen has granted multi-million dollar contracts to a select group of foreign companies.
